title: Wi-Fi Connection Issues
content:
1. Check that Wi-Fi is enabled.
2. Restart the network adapter and reconnect to the correct wireless network.

title: Outlook Email Not Syncing
content:
1. Check your internet connection.
2. Restart Outlook and verify the account settings.
3. Contact IT support if synchronization still fails.

title: Password Reset Problems
content:
1. Verify your username and follow the approved password reset process.
2. Contact the help desk if the reset link has expired.

title: Application Crashing
content:
1. Save your work if possible.
2. Restart the application and check for available updates.
3. Contact IT support if the application continues to crash.

title: Printer Showing Offline
content:
1. Check that the printer is powered on and connected to the network.
2. Verify the selected printer and clear any stuck print jobs.

title: VPN Connection Failure
content:
1. Verify your internet connection and VPN credentials.
2. Restart the VPN client and reconnect.
3. Contact IT support if the connection fails repeatedly.

title: Computer Running Slowly
content:
1. Close unnecessary applications and check available disk space.
2. Restart the computer and contact IT support if performance remains poor.

title: Audio Not Working
content:
1. Check the volume level and confirm the correct audio output device is selected.
2. Reconnect the headset and test the audio again.

title: Reporting a Phishing Email
content:
1. Do not click any links or open attachments in the message.
2. Use the Report Phishing button in your mail client to send it to the security team.
3. Delete the message after reporting it.
4. If you already clicked a link, change your password immediately and contact the IT security team.

title: Suspected Malware or Ransomware
content:
1. Disconnect the device from Wi-Fi and unplug the network cable immediately.
2. Do not shut down or delete any files.
3. Contact the IT security team with the device name and what you saw.
4. Escalate immediately to the security incident response team.

title: Account Locked Out
content:
1. Wait 15 minutes, because accounts unlock automatically after the lockout period.
2. Use the self-service password portal to unlock the account.
3. If the portal is unavailable, contact the help desk to unlock the account.
4. Verify that you can sign in after the unlock.

title: Multi-Factor Authentication Code Not Arriving
content:
1. Check that the phone has network coverage and is not in Do Not Disturb mode.
2. Open the authenticator app and use the code shown there instead of waiting for a text message.
3. If the authenticator device is lost, contact the help desk to reset multi-factor authentication.
4. Verify the sign-in works after the reset.

title: Requesting Access to a Shared Folder
content:
1. Identify the exact folder path or SharePoint site that you need.
2. Submit an access request that includes the folder owner and your business reason.
3. The folder owner or manager must approve the request.
4. Contact the help desk if approval has not been processed after one business day.

title: Software Installation Request
content:
1. Check the company software catalogue for the application.
2. Install approved applications from the self-service portal.
3. If the application is not listed, raise a software request with a business justification.
4. Contact IT support for licence approval.

title: Microsoft Teams Crashing or Freezing
content:
1. Fully quit Teams from the system tray and reopen it.
2. Clear the Teams cache folder and restart the application.
3. Check for available updates and install them.
4. Contact IT support if Teams continues to crash.

title: Windows Update Stuck or Failing
content:
1. Restart the computer and run Windows Update again.
2. Make sure at least 10 GB of disk space is free.
3. Run the Windows Update troubleshooter from Settings.
4. Contact IT support if the same error code returns.

title: Laptop Will Not Power On
content:
1. Connect the original charger and wait 15 minutes.
2. Hold the power button for 15 seconds, then try to start the laptop again.
3. Disconnect all external devices and try again.
4. Contact IT support to arrange a hardware replacement if the laptop still does not start.

title: Monitor Shows No Signal
content:
1. Check that the monitor cable is firmly connected at both ends.
2. Select the correct input source on the monitor.
3. Reconnect the docking station and restart the laptop.
4. Contact IT support if the monitor still shows no signal.

title: No Internet Connection
content:
1. Check that Wi-Fi is on and that you are connected to the corporate network.
2. Restart the network adapter and reconnect.
3. Run the Windows network troubleshooter.
4. Contact IT support if other devices on the same network also have no internet.

title: Shared Mailbox Missing in Outlook
content:
1. Confirm with your manager that you have been granted access to the shared mailbox.
2. Close and reopen Outlook, because new mailboxes can take up to 60 minutes to appear.
3. Add the shared mailbox manually from the account settings.
4. Contact the help desk if the mailbox still does not appear.

title: Mailbox Full
content:
1. Delete large emails and empty the Deleted Items folder.
2. Archive old emails to the online archive.
3. Check your mailbox size in Outlook account settings.
4. Request a quota increase from the help desk if you still cannot receive mail.

title: VPN Slow Performance
content:
1. Disconnect from the VPN and test your internet speed without it.
2. Reconnect to the VPN and select a closer VPN gateway.
3. Close bandwidth-heavy applications while connected.
4. Contact IT support if the VPN remains slow on a good internet connection.
